main.description: Sign the request body into a SCITT Transparent Statement and a badge.blue inline attestation, and return both, together with a did:plc minted for this one request. The body is the artifact: it is signed exactly as sent, so it must be a JSON object (the inline attestation is appended to its signatures array) but its bytes are never re-encoded. The minted DID publishes the request's key as a verification method and carries a #scitt_scrapi service entry whose endpoint is the Receipt, so resolving the DID the attestation names answers both which key signed and where the transparency evidence is.

repository.description: The repository DID the inline attestation is bound to. It is hashed into the content CID, so a signature made for one repository does not verify under another. Defaults to the DID minted for this request.

subject.description: The sub claim of the Signed Statement, which correlates a collection of statements about one artifact. Defaults to the service's configured subject.

schema.description: The artifact to attest to, as a JSON object. Its bytes are the Signed Statement's payload and are signed exactly as sent.

did.description: The did:plc minted for this request. It is the issuer of the inline attestation and the subject of the DID document in this response.

didPublished.description: Whether the genesis operation was submitted to a PLC directory. When false the DID is resolvable by nobody but the holder of this response.

didDocument.description: The DID document for `did`: the request's public key as a verification method, and a #scitt_scrapi service entry whose endpoint is the Receipt.

genesisOperation.description: The signed genesis operation `did` is derived from, so it can be submitted to a PLC directory by whoever holds this response.

repository.description: The repository the attestation was bound to.

contentType.description: The media type of the body, as it arrived.

statement.description: The SCITT Signed Statement and the key that made it.

transparentStatement.description: The Signed Statement as registered, with its Receipt attached.

inlineSignature.description: The badge.blue inline signature entry, as it appears in the signed record's signatures array.

contentCid.description: The content CID the inline signature covers: a hash over the record, the attestation metadata and the repository.

signedRecord.description: The body with the inline signature appended to its signatures array.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The body is not a JSON object, or is empty, so nothing can be attested to.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: A key could not be generated, or the service's own identity could not be read.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The Transparency Service could not be reached, refused the statement, or did not produce a Receipt.

issuer.description: The Signed Statement's iss claim: the did:jwk of the request's key. It is a did:jwk rather than the minted did:plc because the DID names the Receipt, which is a hash of this statement, so it cannot be inside it.

key.description: The request's public key as a JWK.

kid.description: The RFC 7638 thumbprint of that key, which is the COSE kid.

algorithm.description: The COSE algorithm identifier, by name.

coseSign1.description: The COSE_Sign1 Signed Statement, as unpadded base64url.

didKey.description: The same public key as a did:key, for a verifier that cannot resolve the minted DID.

entryId.description: The EntryID of the registration: unpadded base64url of the statement's SHA-256, per Section 2.4 of draft-ietf-scitt-scrapi-11.

location.description: The Receipt resource the Transparency Service named in its Location header.

coseSign1.description: The Signed Statement with the Receipt in its unprotected header under label 394, as unpadded base64url.
